parameters.emailMessage/Subject: FAILED: RMG RML Offline MoreThan 44 Days as per the Redlands Data

parameters.specification/query:
DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		TREATAS({"Offline"}, 'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[Offline > 14 Days])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable2 = 
		TREATAS({"-"}, 'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[PEAK])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable3 = 
		TREATAS({"Offline"}, 'RML_Offline_14Days_Redlands'[Offline > 14 Days])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable4 = 
		FILTER(
			KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('RML_Offline_14Days_X012'[Address])),
			NOT(SEARCH("NDA", 'RML_Offline_14Days_X012'[Address], 1, 0) >= 1)
		)

	VAR __DS0FilterTable5 = 
		FILTER(
			KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('RML_Offline_14Days_X012'[Post Code])),
			NOT('RML_Offline_14Days_X012'[Post Code] IN {""})
		)

	-- NEW -- Add a filter to exclude device names that contain a hyphen
	VAR __DS0FilterTable6 = 
		FILTER(
			KEEPFILTERS(VALUES('RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[Device Name])),
			NOT(SEARCH("-", 'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[Device Name], 1, 0) >= 1)
		)

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SELECTCOLUMNS(
			KEEPFILTERS(
				FILTER(
					KEEPFILTERS(
						SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
							'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[Device Name],
							'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[Serial Number],
							'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[IMEI],
							'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[PEAK],
							'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[Offline > 14 Days],
							'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[Last Seen],
							'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[ICCID],
							'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[Group Path],
							'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[RML Site Name | Code],
							'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[RML Site Code],
							'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[RML Site Name],
							'RML_Offline_14Days_X012'[Address],
							'RML_Offline_14Days_X012'[Asset No.],
							'RML_Offline_14Days_X012'[Status],
							'RML_Offline_14Days_X012'[Stock],
							'RML_Offline_14Days_X012'[Post Code],
							'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[DeviceID],
							__DS0FilterTable,
							__DS0FilterTable2,
							__DS0FilterTable3,
							__DS0FilterTable4,
							__DS0FilterTable5,
							__DS0FilterTable6, -- NEW -- Apply the new filter here
							"CountRowsRML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears", COUNTROWS('RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'),
							"CountRowsRML_Offline_14Days_X012", COUNTROWS('RML_Offline_14Days_X012')
						)
					),
					OR(
						OR(
							OR(
								OR(
									OR(
										OR(
											OR(
												OR(
													OR(
														OR(
															OR(
																OR(
																	OR(
																		OR(
																			OR(
																				OR(
																					NOT(ISBLANK('RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[Device Name])),
																					NOT(ISBLANK('RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[Serial Number]))
																				),
																				NOT(ISBLANK('RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[IMEI]))
																			),
																			NOT(ISBLANK('RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[PEAK]))
																		),
																		NOT(ISBLANK('RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[Offline > 14 Days]))
																	),
																	NOT(ISBLANK('RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[Last Seen]))
																),
																NOT(ISBLANK('RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[ICCID]))
															),
															NOT(ISBLANK('RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[Group Path]))
														),
														NOT(ISBLANK('RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[RML Site Name | Code]))
													),
													NOT(ISBLANK('RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[RML Site Code]))
												),
												NOT(ISBLANK('RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[RML Site Name]))
											),
											NOT(ISBLANK('RML_Offline_14Days_X012'[Address]))
										),
										NOT(ISBLANK('RML_Offline_14Days_X012'[Asset No.]))
									),
									NOT(ISBLANK('RML_Offline_14Days_X012'[Status]))
								),
								NOT(ISBLANK('RML_Offline_14Days_X012'[Stock]))
							),
							NOT(ISBLANK('RML_Offline_14Days_X012'[Post Code]))
						),
						NOT(ISBLANK('RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[DeviceID]))
					)
				)
			),
			"'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[Device Name]", 'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[Device Name],
			"'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[Serial Number]", 'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[Serial Number],
			"'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[IMEI]", 'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[IMEI],
			"'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[PEAK]", 'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[PEAK],
			"'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[Offline > 14 Days]", 'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[Offline > 14 Days],
			"'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[Last Seen]", 'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[Last Seen],
			"'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[ICCID]", 'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[ICCID],
			"'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[Group Path]", 'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[Group Path],
			"'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[RML Site Name | Code]", 'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[RML Site Name | Code],
			"'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[RML Site Code]", 'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[RML Site Code],
			"'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[RML Site Name]", 'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[RML Site Name],
			"'RML_Offline_14Days_X012'[Address]", 'RML_Offline_14Days_X012'[Address],
			"'RML_Offline_14Days_X012'[Asset No.]", 'RML_Offline_14Days_X012'[Asset No.],
			"'RML_Offline_14Days_X012'[Status]", 'RML_Offline_14Days_X012'[Status],
			"'RML_Offline_14Days_X012'[Stock]", 'RML_Offline_14Days_X012'[Stock],
			"'RML_Offline_14Days_X012'[Post Code]", 'RML_Offline_14Days_X012'[Post Code],
			"'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[DeviceID]", 'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[DeviceID]
		)

EVALUATE
	__DS0Core 

ORDER BY
	'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[PEAK] DESC,
	'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[Device Name],
	'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[Serial Number],
	'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[IMEI],
	'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[Offline > 14 Days],
	'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[Last Seen],
	'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[ICCID],
	'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[Group Path],
	'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[RML Site Name | Code],
	'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[RML Site Code],
	'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[RML Site Name],
	'RML_Offline_14Days_X012'[Address],
	'RML_Offline_14Days_X012'[Asset No.],
	'RML_Offline_14Days_X012'[Status],
	'RML_Offline_14Days_X012'[Stock],
	'RML_Offline_14Days_X012'[Post Code],
	'RML_Offline_14_44_Days_42Gears'[DeviceID]

parameters.emailMessage/Subject: RML: ACTION REQUIRED: Devices Offline > 14 days to be updated as lost
parameters.emailMessage/Body:
Good morning,

Please see the list of devices that have been offline for at least 14 days, these devices will be locked in 2 days if they are not powered up beforehand. After they have been locked, if the affected sites locate their PDAs, please ask them to raise an incident with the PDA Service Desk, and they will be unlocked.


@{outputs('Compose_Email')}
Many thanks,


RMG PDA Servicedesk L1
